name: Parameters.exists_algEquiv_norm_eq
summary: σ restricted to K is the identity or complex conjugation; correct by conjugation in the second case.

steps.claim: The restriction of σ to K is one of the two embeddings of the imaginary quadratic field K into ℂ: the inclusion or its complex conjugate (mk_eq_iff). In the first case σ itself fixes K, and σ' = σ. In the second case σ' = σ followed by complex conjugation fixes K, and |σ'(z)| = |conj σ(z)| = |σ(z)|.
steps.lean:
(mk_eq_iff.1 (by
  subsingleton) : .domRestrict σ P.K = _ ∨ _).elim (⟨.ofRingEquiv <| RingHom.congr_fun ·, by tauto⟩)
  (⟨{ σ.trans starRingAut with commutes' := RingHom.congr_fun · }, by simp⟩)
